'''Fin Fizracket''' is a [[goblin]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He is affiliated with the [[Blackwater Raiders]]. He suffered from [[Stranglethorn Fever]], which is cured only by eating the [[Heart of Mokk|heart]] of the [[gorilla]] [[Mokk the Savage]].
